realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Builder
primary.description: Driven to make things real with their own hands.
primary.guiding_promise: I will make something real that endures long after I am gone.
primary.shadow_description: Cannot put the work down long enough to notice what it has quietly cost them.

secondary.label: Custodian
secondary.description: Refuses to let a tradition, language, or way of life slip away; care is not nostalgia but stubborn devotion.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will hold on to what matters, long after others have let it go.
trait_descriptions: Some things must not be lost.
secondary.shadow_description: Guards the tradition so fiercely that nothing — not even necessary growth — is allowed through.

wheel.central_question: Should we speak the pattern before it's proven, or build only what's already real?

growth.label: Custodian
growth.description: Refuses to let a tradition, language, or way of life slip away; care is not nostalgia but stubborn devotion.
growth.guiding_promise: I will hold on to what matters, long after others have let it go.
trait_descriptions: Some things must not be lost.
growth.shadow_description: Guards the tradition so fiercely that nothing — not even necessary growth — is allowed through.

other_ally.label: Healer
other_ally.description: Cares deeply; others' suffering is what they fear most.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will ease what hurts, and protect what heals.
other_ally.shadow_description: Absorbs everyone else's pain until there's nothing left to tend their own.

quarter.label: Storyteller
quarter.description: Keeps identity, memory, and meaning alive across generations; around their fire, people remember who they are.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will keep telling the story, so no one forgets who we are.
trait_descriptions: Keep the soul alive in words.
quarter.shadow_description: Polishes the story so bright that the truth underneath quietly disappears.

opposite.label: Oracle
opposite.description: Notices what hasn't happened yet — through a mind that sees connections others miss.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will speak the pattern I see, even when no one wants to hear it yet.
opposite.shadow_description: Mistakes a hunch for a prophecy, and loses the trust of anyone who asks for proof.

realmmate.label: Democrat
realmmate.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
